details: is a computer vision company that offers a platform for creating computer vision models, called detectors, to search visual media for objects, persons, events, emotions, and actions. Matroid provides real-time notifications once the object of interest has been detected, as well as the ability to search past events.
story: Picture a child pointing at pictures in a book — cat, car, cloud — learning to see by seeing a thousand examples. It turns a picture into an understanding: this is a cat, that is a stop sign. What your eyes do without thinking, the machine does one careful layer at a time. It is eyes made of arithmetic — pixels become edges, edges become shapes, shapes become meaning. That pixel-to-meaning climb is Matroid, Inc..
